newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Managers index falls in September.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Managers index falls in September.

text.p: The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said Monday the trade group's measure of business activity in the region fell in September.

The Chicagoland Business Barometer fell to a seasonally adjusted 56.3 in September from 60.0 in August. An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The index of prices paid by managers who purchase goods for manufacturers rose to 59.3 in September from 51.8 in August.
The employment component of the barometer rose to 50.8 in September from 49.7 in August.
The group said the business barometer "maintains momentum" despite September's drop.
The group said the production index fell four points but remained strong, and new orders held almost all of August's surge despite a slight drop.
